Use this variation when applying during character creation.

Grants the effects of the following:

  • Neural Link: Contains all option slots. None of the additions listed in the Neuroport take up any option slots.

  • Holophone: A functioning phone. Does not have an AI like an Agent.

  • Biomonitor: Monitors the user's health.

  • Virtu (AKA Virtuality): Allows the user to experience virtual events and performances, and can function as Virtuality Goggles. Does not display braindances.

  • HUD (aka Chyron): Displays information from the Biomonitor, HUD, Holophone, etc. Also provides translations for spoken languages.

  • Two Shard Slots (aka Chipware Sockets): Allows the use of Chipware.

  • Personal Link (aka Interface Plug): Allows direct linking to machinery and computers which support it.
